arrival_card.name: All Indonesia arrival card (Indonesia Arrival Card)
arrival_card.submission_window: Can be completed from 3 days before arrival, up to and including on arrival. Mandatory for air and sea arrivals since 1 October 2025.
arrival_card.notes: Directorate General of Immigration requires every arriving passenger, Indonesian and foreign, to submit the All Indonesia arrival declaration. It integrates immigration, customs, health and quarantine, and replaces the standalone customs e-CD at air and sea ports. Land crossings still use ECD Bea Cukai at https://ecd.beacukai.go.id/. This is an arrival declaration, not a visa application, and it does not change visa or visa-exemption eligibility.

fields.passport_validity: Passport valid for at least 6 months upon arrival
required_documents: Passport valid for at least 6 months upon arrival
fields.onward_travel_evidence: Present an outbound ticket from Indonesia upon arrival
fields.financial_evidence: Have sufficient living expenses while in Indonesia.
fields.entry_requirements: For air and sea arrivals, complete the All Indonesia arrival declaration at https://allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id/. It integrates immigration, customs, health and quarantine declarations and can be completed from 3 days before arrival or upon landing. For land arrivals, Indonesian Customs directs travellers to the electronic customs declaration at https://ecd.beacukai.go.id/. Follow the declaration system required at your crossing; All Indonesia replaces the separate customs declaration where that system is implemented. Arrival declarations do not replace the applicable visa or exemption.

supporting_evidence.quote: Arrival forms for immigration, customs, health, and quarantine (arrival cards) are now integrated into a single digital system through this application. Passengers can fill out the All Indonesia form three days before arriving in Indonesia from their country of origin and upon landing.

With this integration, international passengers arriving in Indonesia, whether through airports, seaports, or land borders where All Indonesia has been implemented, no longer need to fill out an electronic customs declaration (e-CD), as all customs declaration processes are already combined in this integrated digital system.

Arrival Card Submission is Required All travellers are required to submit an arrival card within 3 (three) days prior arrival in Indonesia
Submit Arrival Card Now

entry_requirements.quote: Kedatangan Melalui Udara dan Laut (Aplikasi All Indonesia) Saat ini, Indonesia menerapkan sistem satu pintu melalui layanan All Indonesia. Layanan ini mengintegrasikan informasi imigrasi, bea cukai (Customs Declaration), kesehatan, hingga karantina dalam satu tautan. Hal ini membuat proses kedatangan menjadi lebih cepat, mudah, dan aman. Akses: allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id Waktu Pengisian: Dapat diisi mulai 3 hari (H-3) sebelum jadwal kedatangan Anda di Indonesia. Cara: Pilih kategori Warga Negara Indonesia atau Pengunjung Asing, lalu ikuti petunjuk pengisian hingga selesai. Kedatangan Melalui Darat dan Keberangkatan Luar Negeri (ECD Bea Cukai) Khusus bagi penumpang yang tiba melalui jalur darat (PLBN) atau penumpang yang akan berangkat ke luar negeri (ekspor) dengan membawa uang tunai (setara Rp100 juta atau lebih) serta barang-barang tertentu lainnya, pengisian formulir dilakukan melalui: Akses: ecd.beacukai.go.id Waktu Pengisian: Dapat diisi mulai 3 hari (H-3) sebelum jadwal kedatangan Anda di Indonesia.

fields.application_channel_detail: Register the e-passport before departure on the Japan Visa Exemption System (JAVES) and show the registration notice on your phone or tablet at the airport. Printouts and screenshots are not accepted. Paper registration with a sticker is still available at the Japan Visa Application Center (JVAC) in Jakarta or a consulate general, in about 2 to 3 working days. Travellers who do not register apply for a paper visa through JVAC by appointment, or for the JAPAN eVISA through an accredited agency. Residents of Indonesia cannot apply on the JAPAN eVISA website themselves.

No claim is made about symptom screening at quarantine, which MHLW still performs.
